Definition: Whether the digital ID is recognized or interoperable across borders through regional agreements or travel documents
Comments: No evidence of formal cross-border interoperability or regional recognition of the DRC national ID/DRCPass found. DRC is a COMESA and SADC member state, and COMESA is working on cross-border trade facilitation, but the DRC national ID is not part of any formally interoperable regional identity framework. The DRCPass is a new system in early rollout with no regional recognition agreements announced. The COMESA Simplified Trade Regime at Kasumbalesa (DRC-Zambia) facilitates trade but does not entail ID interoperability. Searched for SADC/COMESA ID recognition for DRC specifically; no formal agreements found.
